Upgrade to WebSocket. ClientMessage and ServerEvent are the message schema roots.
Authenticate with the session cookie or Authorization: Bearer, never a query token.
Cookie auth requires a matching allowed Origin (configured, same-origin by default);
reject a missing/foreign Origin with 403. Bearer clients need no Origin header.
get.description:
On subscribe: first register the live subscription, queueing events per connection;
replay committed messages with seq > after_seq ascending in pages of up to 50
messages; flush queued live events with seq > last replayed;
then send subscribed with caught_up_seq. Clients dedupe by (channel_id, seq):
duplicates are harmless, gaps are forbidden. Publish only committed new messages.
Queue overflow closes with 4008 (never silently drops an event); reconnect and
re-subscribe from the last seq per channel. Expiry/sign-out closes with 4001;
stop protected delivery and go to Sign in. Membership loss closes only this
Organization with 4003: terminal unavailable, never reconnect/resubscribe/retry sends.
A rejected handshake has no close code: check GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/me.
Every text or binary frame (subscribe, unsubscribe, invalid) is charged to a
per-connection and a per-Account budget before any database access; over
budget closes with 4029: reconnect with backoff. A subscribe for a Channel
already subscribed on this connection is ignored (no reply), whatever its after_seq.

newer for after_seq). Continue after_seq with the last seq or before_seq
with the first seq; continue the latest page toward older messages with before_seq.

messages.description: Always ascending seq (newest last), including latest and before_seq pages.

token.description: Opaque bearer credential. Store securely; returned only on native sign-in.

has_more.description: More matching Messages follow; continue after the last returned seq.

messages.description: Root and all descendants, ascending by seq. Projection only: never moves the sync cursor.

after_seq.description: Exclusive forward continuation; omitted/0 starts with the root.

body.description: 1..=4000 Unicode scalar values; no NUL or whitespace-only body. Stored without trimming.

reply_to.description:
Confirmed parent in this Organization/Channel. Omitted/null is a non-Reply.
A Reply inherits its parent's Topic; topic_name must be omitted/null.

topic_name.description:
Join or create a Topic in this Channel. Omitted/null sends without a Topic unless replying.
1..=60 Unicode scalars, no NUL or surrounding/only trim whitespace; ASCII case folds.

ServerEvent.description: Server -> client events. Clients dedupe messages by (channel_id, seq).

password.description: At least 12 characters, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

setup_token.description: Must match the server's required FUKULOW_SETUP_TOKEN.

after_seq.description: Replay committed messages with seq > after_seq; 0 starts at the beginning.

Subscribed.description: Sent after committed replay and queued live events have been handed off.

caught_up_seq.description: Last sequence caught up through; 0 when the channel has no messages.

items.description: Ascending W-relative positions, newest last. Continue older with the first position.

last_seq.description: W-relative display position; unaffected by Messages after the enclosing as_of_seq.

message_count.description: Absolute count at the enclosing as_of_seq, excluding later Messages.

read_seq.description: Current Member position, independent of the Channel main timeline.

unread_count.description: Other senders' Messages above read_seq, bounded by the enclosing as_of_seq.

as_of_seq.description: Latest committed Channel seq in the positions/counts snapshot; 0 if empty.

main_unread_count.description: Other senders' Messages without Topic above read_seq, bounded by as_of_seq.

read_seq.description: Current Member position for Messages without Topic; independent of as_of_seq.

unread_count.description: Channel badge: main-timeline Unread plus all Topic Unread, bounded by as_of_seq.

cookie.name: __Host-fukulow_session
cookie.description: HTTPS production cookie; local HTTP with FUKULOW_COOKIE_SECURE=false uses fukulow_session
